settings.name: USE_CLIENT_CACHE
settings.description: **Enable Client Cache:** Set to `yes` to enable client-side caching of static files.

settings.name: CLIENT_CACHE_EXTENSIONS
settings.description: **Cacheable Extensions:** List of file extensions (separated by pipes) that should be cached by the client.

settings.name: CLIENT_CACHE_CONTROL
settings.description: **Cache-Control Header:** Value for the Cache-Control HTTP header to control caching behavior.

settings.name: CLIENT_CACHE_ETAG
settings.description: **Enable ETags:** Set to `yes` to send the HTTP ETag header for static resources.
